title: Roads?
content: So I have this dream recurring where there is a giant highway that goes into the sky, and curves so hard that sometimes the cars fall off, or "Launch off" and then it goes straight down, I've definitely launched off before, and I was talking about this with my dad and he told me he has the same one, but a little different. Sometimes I'm driving, sometimes I'm a passenger and there is no driver. Anyone else been to this highway/Road?
